artworks.title: Ixion and Nephele
artworks.description: Fuseli stages Ixion embracing the cloud Nephele — the union that begets Centaurus, progenitor of the horse-men. The cloud-crime before the race of centaurs spreads.

artworks.title: Ixion Worshipping Hera Disguised as a Cloud
artworks.description: Fuseli again: Ixion before the false Hera — the cloud that will birth Centaurus, father of the wild centaur kind (distinct from wise Chiron).

artworks.title: Ixion Embracing a Cloud
artworks.artist: Unknown (after the Loves of Juno series)
artworks.description: MET engraving: Ixion clasps the cloud — the generative scene from which Centaurus, and then the centaurs, descend in mythographic tradition.

artworks.title: Ixion and Nephele
artworks.description: Print of Ixion with the cloud-nymph Nephele — the parentage of Centaurus made visible as embrace rather than as a later herd of horse-men.

popCulture.title: Centaurus (Greek mythology)
popCulture.description: Son of Ixion and Nephele (or of Zeus and a cloud) — progenitor of the centaurs; not the constellation Centaurus nor the galaxy Centaurus A.

popCulture.title: Ixion
popCulture.description: Father of Centaurus by the cloud — the Lapith king whose desire for Hera seeds the centaur race before his wheel in Tartarus.

popCulture.title: Nephele
popCulture.description: The cloud shaped like Hera — mother of Centaurus in the Ixion tale (a different Nephele is mother of Phrixus and Helle).
